name: Inspired by Blue Ribbon Pines (East Bethel, MN)

holes.name: Hole 1
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend.

holes.name: Hole 2
holes.obstacleNotes: A tight tree-lined corridor: low and straight, with little room to curve.

holes.name: Hole 3
holes.obstacleNotes: S-curve: the lane bends right then left between wooded corners.

holes.name: Hole 4
holes.obstacleNotes: Low bushes fill the right half of the fairway: keep it left or throw high over them.

holes.name: Hole 6
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend. Out of bounds right (a creek bank): stay on the fairway side.

holes.name: Hole 7
holes.obstacleNotes: Tall trees guard the middle; the open lane is right: start right and fade back left (hyzer).

holes.name: Hole 8
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend. Water left of the fairway: bail out the other way.

holes.name: Hole 10
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg left: the woods on the inside shut the straight line, so shape a hyzer around the bend.

holes.name: Hole 11
holes.obstacleNotes: S-curve: the lane bends left then right between wooded corners.

holes.name: Hole 12
holes.obstacleNotes: Tall trees guard the middle; the open lane is left: start left and work back right (flex or anhyzer).

holes.name: Hole 13
holes.obstacleNotes: A tight tree-lined corridor: low and straight, with little room to curve.

holes.name: Hole 14
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend.

holes.name: Hole 16
holes.obstacleNotes: Water left of the fairway: bail out the other way.

holes.name: Hole 18
holes.obstacleNotes: Dogleg right: the inside corner is wooded; work an anhyzer (or forehand hyzer) round the bend.

layouts.name: Inspired 18
layouts.description: UNVERIFIED, INVENTED: no real per-hole data was found for this course; pars and lengths are made up in the style of the real course and do not match it. Fairway bends, bushes, tree blockers, water and OB are invented shaping, not surveyed features of the real course.
